name: Xingmu Xieyue A.A.A.
source:
"Starveil protocol A.A.A." was originally called "Reconnect", and it is a short text adventure experimental DEMO mixed with traditional role-playing game elements. The current version of the game is a new version based on the old "Reconnect" game which was made in a 3 week long Chinese game jam (Gcores BOOOM 2023 Vol.1). This new version adds some system refinement updates and iterations of art assets.

The main feature of this game is that the gameplay will feature a fair amount of random encounters and random scenarios to explore with in the story, and players will need to overcome these scenarios with the luck of a dice and their character's skill building as in traditional tabletop role-playing games.

[From [url=https://inkfield.itch.io/starveil-protocol]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“星幕协议A.A.A.”原名《Reconnect》，是一款混合了传统角色扮演游戏元素的短文冒险实验DEMO。游戏当前版本是基于旧版《Reconnect》游戏的新版本，该游戏是在为期三周的中国游戏大赛（Gcores BOOOM 2023 Vol.1）中制作的。这个新版本增加了一些系统细化更新和美术资产的迭代。

该游戏的主要特点是游戏玩法将在故事中探索大量的随机遭遇和随机场景，玩家需要像传统桌面角色扮演游戏一样依靠骰子的运气和角色的技能建设来克服这些场景。

[来自[url=https://inkfield.itch.io/starveil-protocol]itch.io[/url]]
